author: China Insights
description:
Why has former Chinese leader Hu Jintao been declared "dead" eight different times over the past 13 years?

From viral death hoaxes to the mysterious removal at the 20th Party Congress, Hu Jintao has become one of the most symbolic figures in China's political rumors.

In this episode, we examine the latest fake report, the role of influential media figures, and why every rumor surrounding Hu Jintao reflects deeper power struggles inside Zhongnanhai.
